missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend an additional B12 product until current form, amount, frequency, adherence and fortified-food intake are reconciled.
safety_exclusions: Do not duplicate existing B12 supplementation.
Do not claim methylcobalamin is routinely superior to other effective B12 forms.
Do not infer adequacy solely from reported use without considering adherence and absorption.
professional_escalation_conditions: Neurological symptoms, pernicious anemia, malabsorption, gastrointestinal surgery or abnormal B12-related labs.
population_and_context: People already using vitamin B12 supplements who are considering methylcobalamin or another B12 product.
dose_constraints: No additional dose from this rule. Reconcile reliable total intake and seek clinical assessment if deficiency is suspected.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS B12 fact sheet describes forms and sources; product form does not establish superior clinical outcomes. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
